structured_output.rationale: Lines 1-3 (97110) deny CO-236 (PTP bundling, Column Two code) against the 97150 on line 4 (07-ncci-and-mue.md §a). The 835 carries neither the partner code nor the CCMI; the reference requires the PTP edit file's CCMI value for this pair in the 2026-Q3 DOS quarter before routing. Chart note documents a separate demarcated time segment, different body region, and unrelated goal for 97110 vs 97150, which supports a bypass modifier only if CCMI=1. If CCMI=0, correct disposition is do_not_resubmit/write-off regardless of documentation; if CCMI=9, disposition is appeal. Cannot be determined from artifacts alone.

awaiting_human.question: For CPT pair 97110/97150 billed on DOS 2026-06-25 (Medicare NCCI PTP edit file, 2026 Q3), what is the CCMI (Correct Coding Modifier Indicator) — 0, 1, or 9?
awaiting_human.why_needed: The CCMI value determines whether the CO-236 denial is fixable by adding a bypass/anatomic modifier and resubmitting (CCMI=1, supported by chart note documentation of separate encounter/site/goal), an unappealable write-off (CCMI=0), or an appeal challenging edit applicability (CCMI=9). Neither the 835 nor 837P carries this indicator.
